systems.platform: QR-coded digital address plates linked to a centralised property data system, built with the geospatial firm Interspatial
systems.owner: Lagos State Government (Enterprise Geographic Information System, e-GIS); fully state-funded
systems.tiers: Lagos State; piloted in Eti-Osa Local Government Area from June 2025, to scale across all 57 local governments and local council development areas

note: A state government's property-addressing system, launched 24 June 2025 and piloted in one local government area; the areas are where plates are fixed. Nothing on local government offices or their connection.
